title: Private Pikes Peak COG Railway, Manitou & Garden of the Gods
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Visitors to Pikes Peak should be aware that altitude sickness can occur due to the mountain's 14,115-foot elevation, potentially causing dizziness, nausea, headaches, and shortness of breath; staying hydrated and acclimating properly can help mitigate these effects.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through some of Colorado’s most iconic landscapes on our America’s Mountain Experience.. This adventure begins with a ride on the historic Pikes Peak Cog Railway, the highest cog railway in the world, as it climbs to the summit of America’s Mountain (14,115 ft). Along the way, take in breathtaking alpine views, spot wildlife, and experience the thrill of reaching the top, where sweeping panoramas stretch as far as the eye can see.

Manitou Springs is known for its unique shops, art galleries, and natural mineral springs. Stroll through the historic streets, enjoy lunch at one of the many great restaurants, and soak in the town’s eclectic, laid-back atmosphere.

Garden of the Gods is a world-famous natural landmark featuring towering red rock formations set against a backdrop of Pikes Peak. Enjoy a leisurely walk among the dramatic rock spires, learn about the park’s fascinating geology, and capture incredible photos of this breathtaking landscape.
